stories.h: Flamingos beat Brazil 3-1 to reach first U-17 Women's World Cup final
stories.p: Nigeria's Flamingos have reached the final of the FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup for the first time after beating Brazil 3-1 in the semi-final. Awawu Bashiru scored twice and Queen Joseph once. They face Japan in the final.
body: Nigeria's under-17 women's team, the Flamingos, have made history by reaching the final of the FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup for the first time.
## The match

The Flamingos beat Brazil 3-1 in the semi-final on Wednesday night, 4 November 2026, according to reports. Queen Joseph opened the scoring in the 56th minute, and Awawu Bashiru doubled the lead in the 71st minute before adding her second goal in the 80th minute to put the game beyond Brazil's reach.
## A record run

The win beats the team's previous best performance, a bronze medal at the 2022 edition of the tournament. On the way to the semi-final, the Flamingos beat Venezuela in the quarter-finals, a result that earned praise from the Confederation of African Football.
## The final

The Flamingos will now face Japan in the final as they chase Nigeria's first FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup title. Japan, one of the strongest sides in women's youth football, won the tournament in 2014.
## Background

The result comes at a difficult time for Nigerian women's football at senior level. The Super Falcons failed to qualify for the Women's World Cup for the first time, and no Nigerian player was shortlisted for this year's CAF Women's Player of the Year award. The Flamingos' success has been welcomed as a sign that a new generation of players is coming through.
## How people reacted
Nigerians celebrated the win across social media, praising the young players and their coaches and urging the government and the football federation to support them ahead of the final.
more: Awawu Bashiru scored twice and Queen Joseph once.
It is Nigeria's first U-17 Women's World Cup final.
The Flamingos face Japan in the final.

stories.h: NJC suspends three judges for a year without pay over misconduct
stories.p: The National Judicial Council has suspended three judicial officers for one year without pay and cautioned eight others over misconduct, including unlawful detention of litigants. One judge was also barred from promotion for three years.
body: The National Judicial Council (NJC) has suspended three judicial officers for one year without pay over misconduct, according to reports on Wednesday, 4 November 2026.
## The decisions

The decisions were taken at the council's 112th meeting on 3 November, chaired by the Chief Justice of Nigeria, Justice Kudirat Kekere-Ekun. The council also issued cautions to eight others and approved warning letters to three judges following investigations into petitions about their conduct. The offences included unlawful detention of litigants, abuse of judicial authority and breaches of due process.
## Who was suspended

Those suspended were reportedly Justice Hannatu Mohammed Kabir of the Nasarawa State High Court, Grand Kadi Mohammed Sani Salihu of the Jigawa State Sharia Court of Appeal and Justice Sobere Biambo of the Rivers State High Court. The council said Justice Kabir ordered the arrest and detention of a litigant for 58 days over alleged disobedience of a court order without following proper contempt procedures, and barred her from consideration for promotion for three years. Grand Kadi Salihu was suspended over his role in reopening a judgment already delivered by an FCT Upper Area Court.
## Background

The NJC is the body responsible for disciplining judges in Nigeria. Public trust in the judiciary has been a recurring concern, particularly over election cases and conflicting court orders. Civil society groups have repeatedly called on the council to act firmly against judicial misconduct ahead of the 2027 elections, when courts are expected to handle many disputes.
## Why it matters
Observers say the decisions send a signal that judges will be held accountable for abusing their powers.
more: Three judicial officers were suspended for a year without pay.
Eight others were cautioned.
One judge detained a litigant for 58 days without due process.

stories.h: UK court rejects Ibori's appeal to cut £101.5m confiscation order
stories.p: The Court of Appeal in London has dismissed former Delta governor James Ibori's bid to reduce a £101.5 million confiscation order made after his 2012 conviction for money laundering. Ibori says he is consulting his lawyers.
body: Britain's Court of Appeal has dismissed a challenge by former Delta State governor James Ibori to reduce a £101.5 million confiscation order against him, according to reports.
## The ruling

The court rejected the appeal on Tuesday, 3 November 2026. Ibori had sought to reduce the amount by about £4.3 million. The order was issued by Southwark Crown Court in July 2023, directing him to pay or face an eight-year prison term in default. The appeal had delayed enforcement, which can now proceed unless he takes the case to the UK Supreme Court.
## Ibori's response
Ibori reportedly said he was consulting his lawyers on his next steps and expressed frustration at how long the proceedings had taken.
## Background

Ibori governed Delta State from 1999 to 2007. He was arrested in Dubai and extradited to Britain in 2011. In 2012 he pleaded guilty in a London court to laundering tens of millions of dollars of public funds through British banks and properties, and was sentenced to 13 years in prison. He was released in late 2016 after serving about half of the sentence and returned to Nigeria in 2017. The confiscation proceedings followed investigations by Nigerian and British anti-corruption authorities, and Nigeria has pushed for the recovered funds to be returned.
## Why it matters
The case is one of the most significant examples of international cooperation to recover stolen public funds from Nigeria.
more: The order is for £101.5 million.
Ibori wanted it reduced by about £4.3 million.
He says he is consulting his lawyers.

stories.h: Reps bill would let regulators shut hospitals that refuse emergency patients
stories.p: A bill to amend the National Health Act has passed second reading in the House of Representatives. It would require hospitals to begin triage within 15 minutes and stabilise emergency patients within 30 minutes, or risk losing their licences.
body: A bill that would allow regulators to suspend or revoke the licences of hospitals that refuse or delay emergency treatment has passed its second reading in the House of Representatives.
## What the bill says

The bill, sponsored by House spokesman Akin Rotimi and debated on Wednesday, 4 November 2026, seeks to amend the National Health Act 2014 by setting mandatory timelines for emergency care. Under the proposal, facilities would have to begin assessing a patient within 15 minutes of arrival and provide basic stabilisation within 30 minutes. Where a life-threatening condition is identified, staff would have to start lifesaving treatment immediately, and hospitals with a free bed would have to assign it to an emergency patient.
## Why it is needed

Section 20 of the existing Act already bans health workers and facilities from refusing emergency treatment, with a fine of ₦100,000, up to six months in prison, or both. However, some hospitals have continued to turn emergency patients away or demand payment before treatment. Rotimi said delays, administrative hurdles, upfront payment demands and poor referrals were still causing avoidable complications and deaths, and that the amendment would make clear who is responsible and how quickly they must act.
## Background

There have been many reports in Nigeria of accident and gunshot victims, pregnant women and others dying after being refused care because they could not pay a deposit or provide a police report. The government has previously said hospitals must treat gunshot victims without waiting for police clearance.
## What happens next
The bill will now go to committee for further work before returning to the House for third reading.
more: Hospitals would have to begin triage within 15 minutes.
Basic stabilisation would be required within 30 minutes.
Facilities that refuse care could lose their licences.

stories.h: Peller turns down $50,000 offer to let fan name his unborn child
stories.p: Streamer Peller has reportedly turned down a $50,000 offer from crypto trader Habby Forex to name his unborn child during a livestream, saying money is not everything and he will not use his family for cash.
body: Popular streamer Peller has rejected a large cash offer in exchange for the right to name his unborn child.
## What happened

During a livestream, reported on Wednesday, 4 November 2026, cryptocurrency trader Habby Forex offered Peller $50,000, about ₦70 million, to choose the name of the baby Peller is expecting with his wife, fellow content creator Jarvis. Peller initially seemed surprised when the amount was converted into naira and said he would have to discuss it with his wife. But after asking what name Habby Forex had in mind, he turned the offer down.
## What he said
Peller reportedly said money is not everything and that he does not play with his family when it comes to money.
## Background

Peller, whose real name is Habeeb Adelaja, is one of Nigeria's most-followed TikTok streamers. He and Jarvis held their white wedding in Lekki, Lagos, in August. Earlier this week he apologised after a livestream in which he called himself Jesus Christ, which drew widespread criticism. Large cash gifts and offers on livestreams have become common among Nigerian streamers and their wealthy fans.
## How fans reacted
Many fans praised Peller for putting his family first, while others joked that they would have accepted the money. Some questioned whether the offer was genuine.
more: Habby Forex offered about ₦70 million to name the baby.
Peller said he would not use his family for money.
He and Jarvis married in August.

stories.h: Rochas Okorocha and Governor Hope Uzodinma seen laughing and singing together despite political rivalry. Who is fooling who?
stories.p: Former Imo State Governor Rochas Okorocha and current Governor Hope Uzodinma have been seen smiling, joking and singing together, even though their camps have been locked in a legal dispute over a senatorial candidacy. The moment is a reminder to supporters not to turn politics into personal wars.
body: Nigerian politics will teach you lessons no classroom ever can.
Just look at former Imo State Governor Rochas Okorocha and the current governor, Hope Uzodinma, smiling, joking and singing together like two old friends who have never had a political disagreement.
## Rivals on paper
These are the same political figures whose camps have been involved in a legal dispute over a senatorial candidacy.

Yet here they are, laughing and enjoying themselves, while some of their supporters are outside exchanging insults, fighting imaginary battles and treating political disagreements like personal family wars.
## The real problem

Some supporters have destroyed friendships, fought their neighbours and made enemies of people they have known for years, all because of politicians who can sit together tomorrow, shake hands and laugh over a bottle of expensive wine.

The painful part is that some supporters are even willing to risk their lives defending these politicians. Meanwhile, the politicians themselves understand that politics is a game of interests, and today's enemy can become tomorrow's ally.
Look at Rochas and Hope again. Do they look like people who cannot stand each other?
## A lesson for supporters
This should be a serious lesson to Nigerians, especially those who insult, threaten and attack others over political differences.
Support whoever you want. Campaign for your preferred candidate. But never allow political loyalty to turn you into an enemy of your fellow citizens.
At the end of the day, the politicians you are fighting for may be laughing together while you are still carrying their quarrel on your head.
## Over to you
Nigerians, when will we learn that politicians are not worth dying for? Look at the picture and tell us: who is really fooling who?
more: Okorocha and Uzodinma were seen laughing and singing together.
Their camps have clashed in court over a senatorial ticket.
Supporters are urged not to make politics personal.
stories.alt: Rochas Okorocha, Governor Hope Uzodinma and other politicians laughing together at an indoor gathering

stories.h: "VeryDarkMan, you have gone too far. Respect Davido's marriage and leave Chioma out of this": Content creator Roskey blasts VDM
stories.p: Content creator Roskey has called out VeryDarkMan for resurfacing a video of Davido enjoying Zlatan's song, saying VDM should respect the singer's marriage to Chioma. He also asked why VDM has not gone after Carter Efe, who insulted his mother.
body: Content creator Roskey has called out social media activist VeryDarkMan (VDM) over his decision to resurface a video involving Nigerian music superstar Davido, popularly known as OBO.
According to Roskey, some things should be left alone, especially when a married man and his family could be dragged into unnecessary controversy.
## "You went too far"
Roskey questioned why VDM would bring back a video of Davido enjoying Zlatan's song, knowing fully well that the singer is now married to Chioma.
What appears to have upset him even more is that VDM attended Davido's wedding. In Roskey's view, that alone should have been reason enough for VDM to show some restraint.
"VeryDarkMan, you went too far by posting that video of Davido. You know OBO is married now, and his wife, Chioma, won't be happy seeing that video circulating again," Roskey said.
He argued that marriage comes with responsibilities, and that people who have access to celebrities should know when to draw the line.
## "He barely danced"

Roskey also questioned what Davido actually did in the video to deserve so much attention. According to him, Davido barely danced in the footage. He simply raised his hand while Zlatan's song was playing.
So why make such a big issue out of something that looked so harmless?
## The Carter Efe question
Roskey went further and questioned VDM's priorities, bringing up his clash with fellow entertainer Carter Efe, who recently made insulting remarks about VDM's mother in a video.
"Why haven't you gone after Carter Efe, who insulted your mother? Why are you targeting Davido? Or is there something you're not telling us?" he asked.

That last question has added another layer to the controversy. Roskey appears to believe there may be more behind VDM's decision to revisit the Davido video, although he presented no evidence of any hidden motive.
## What about Davido's marriage?

Roskey's bigger concern is the possible effect of these online fights on Davido's marriage. Celebrities are constantly under public scrutiny, but he believes there should be some consideration for their spouses and families, particularly when old videos are brought back into circulation.
Whether the video poses any real threat to Davido's marriage remains a matter of speculation, and there is no sign that Chioma has publicly expressed displeasure over the footage.
For now, Roskey's message to VDM is clear: whatever point he is trying to make, Davido's marriage should not become collateral damage.
## Over to you
Did VeryDarkMan genuinely cross the line by reposting the video, or is Roskey making too much of an ordinary clip of Davido enjoying music?
more: Roskey says VDM should respect Davido's marriage to Chioma.
He says Davido barely danced in the clip.
He asked why VDM has not gone after Carter Efe.

stories.h: Thugs attack Peter Obi's convoy in Calabar, one arrested
stories.p: Suspected thugs attacked NDC presidential candidate Peter Obi's convoy in Calabar on Wednesday, throwing stones and bottles. Police say one suspect has been arrested. Obi blamed APC supporters, a claim the party has not answered.
body: The convoy of Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC) presidential candidate Peter Obi was attacked by suspected political thugs in Calabar, Cross River State, on Wednesday, 4 November 2026.
## What happened

According to reports, the attack happened around the Watt Market area as Obi's convoy moved through the city towards a hotel where the party had scheduled a presidential town hall meeting. Obi was in Calabar with his wife, Margaret, and his running mate, Rabiu Kwankwaso. Attackers threw stones, bottles and other objects at vehicles and supporters who had lined the route. Several supporters were reportedly injured and vehicles were damaged. An aide to Obi, Esther Umoh, said one supporter was hit by a stray bullet.
## Police response
The Cross River State Police Command confirmed the incident and said a 27-year-old suspect had been arrested. Police said investigations were continuing to identify those behind the attack.
## What Obi said

Speaking after the incident, Obi alleged that APC supporters threw stones at his convoy, forcing people to run for safety. He said such attacks happen because Nigerians tolerate them, and vowed that it would not be allowed in 2027. The APC had not responded to the claim at the time of reporting.
## Background

Cross River is governed by the APC. Attacks on campaign events have increased as the January 2027 elections approach. Earlier this week, ADC candidate Atiku Abubakar accused the DSS of plotting to disrupt his Sokoto rally, and APC supporters were attacked ahead of a rally in Katsina. Civil society groups and religious leaders have urged all parties to restrain their supporters.
more: Attackers threw stones and bottles at the convoy.
Police arrested one suspect.
Obi blamed APC supporters; the party has not responded.

stories.alt: Peter Obi

stories.h: Tinubu departs Saudi Arabia for Abuja after Umrah
stories.p: President Tinubu has left Jeddah for Abuja after completing his Umrah in Makkah, according to his spokesman. He was seen off by the Deputy Governor of the Makkah Region and Nigerian diplomats.
body: President Bola Tinubu has left Saudi Arabia for Abuja after completing his Umrah, or lesser pilgrimage, in Makkah.
## The departure

According to a statement by presidential spokesman Bayo Onanuga, the President's aircraft took off from the Royal Terminal of King Abdulaziz International Airport in Jeddah at 5.13pm Saudi time on Wednesday, 4 November 2026. He was seen off by the Deputy Governor of the Makkah Region, Prince Saud bin Mishal bin Abdulaziz Al Saud, Nigeria's ambassador to Saudi Arabia, Yakubu Gambo, and the Consul-General, Muazam Ibrahim Nayaya. Before leaving, the President held a brief meeting with the deputy governor at the Royal Guest Palace in the airport.
## Background

Tinubu left Abuja for Makkah on 29 October. During the trip he was granted the rare honour of entering the Kaaba with his delegation, where he said he prayed for peace, unity and prosperity for Nigeria. He also hosted governors and senior officials at a dinner in Makkah. The trip drew comment from opposition figures, with Atiku Abubakar's campaign saying it would not guarantee him a second term and activist Omoyele Sowore claiming it was for medical treatment, which the Presidency denied.
## What happens next
The President is expected to resume official duties in Abuja. Among matters awaiting him is his request to the Senate for approval of $7.7 billion in new foreign borrowing.
more: The President left Jeddah at 5.13pm Saudi time.
He was seen off by the Deputy Governor of Makkah.
He had left Abuja on 29 October.

stories.alt: President Bola Tinubu

stories.h: Osimhen left off CAF Men's Player of the Year shortlist
stories.p: Victor Osimhen has reportedly been left out of CAF's 10-man shortlist for the 2026 Men's Player of the Year award, despite helping Nigeria win AFCON bronze and Galatasaray win the Turkish league. Reigning winner Achraf Hakimi heads the list.
body: Super Eagles striker Victor Osimhen has been left out of the shortlist for the 2026 CAF Men's Player of the Year award, according to nominations released by the Confederation of African Football on Wednesday, 4 November.
## The snub

The 27-year-old had what many considered a strong year. He helped Nigeria finish third at the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations in Morocco and was a key figure as Galatasaray won the Turkish Super Lig title in 2026. Osimhen won the award in 2023, becoming the first Nigerian to do so since Nwankwo Kanu in 1999.
## Who made the list

The reigning African Player of the Year, Morocco and Paris Saint-Germain defender Achraf Hakimi, heads the 10-man shortlist, which reportedly also includes Senegal's Sadio Mané, Ghana's Antoine Semenyo and Ivory Coast's Amad Diallo.
## Background

The omission follows news this week that no Nigerian player made the shortlist for the women's award for the first time since it began in 2001. Nigeria still has nominations in other categories, including the Super Falcons for Women's National Team of the Year. The CAF Awards ceremony will be held on 7 December at the Wole Soyinka Centre for Culture and the Creative Arts in Lagos.
## How people reacted
Nigerian fans reacted angrily, with many saying Osimhen's achievements deserved recognition and questioning how the shortlist was chosen. Others said the competition was strong this year.
more: Osimhen won AFCON bronze and the Turkish league title.
Achraf Hakimi heads the 10-man shortlist.
The awards hold in Lagos on 7 December.

stories.alt: Victor Osimhen in a Nigeria jersey

stories.h: Seyi Vibez gifts his father a second house in Lagos
stories.p: Singer Seyi Vibez has celebrated buying his father a second house, congratulating him in an Instagram post with a video of the property. Fans praised him for honouring his parent.
body: Street-pop singer Seyi Vibez has given his father a new house, his second, and shared the moment with fans.
## What happened

In an Instagram post on Wednesday, 4 November 2026, the singer congratulated his father on the property, writing that he celebrated him and adding a word of thanks to God. He also shared a video of the house.
## Background

Seyi Vibez, real name Oluwaseyi Balogun, rose to fame in recent years with a run of popular songs and albums and has become one of the leading voices in Nigeria's street-pop scene. He often speaks about his family and his humble beginnings in Lagos. Gifting parents houses and cars has become a popular way for Nigerian stars to show gratitude.
## How fans reacted
Fans flooded the post with congratulations, praising the singer for taking care of his father and praying for more success. Many said it was a good example for young people who make money early.
more: It is his father's second house.
He shared a video of the property.
Fans praised him for honouring his father.

stories.h: Government says ₦50,000 NERSI beneficiaries will be chosen from official records, not applications
stories.p: The federal government says beneficiaries of its ₦50,000 monthly National Emergency Relief and Stabilisation Intervention will be selected through verified government records and set criteria, not by applying or being nominated. It warned against scams.
body: The federal government has explained how it will choose beneficiaries for its National Emergency Relief and Stabilisation Intervention (NERSI), which pays ₦50,000 a month to vulnerable Nigerians.
## How people will be selected

According to reports on Wednesday, 4 November 2026, the government said beneficiaries will be identified strictly through verified official records and defined eligibility criteria, rather than through applications or nominations. Only people who meet the set criteria will be considered.
## Scam warnings

Officials have warned Nigerians not to share their PINs or one-time passwords with anyone who calls claiming to represent the programme, and have explained who may collect the payment on a beneficiary's behalf. Several digital banks and payment platforms have also published guidance on how to check eligibility.
## Background

NERSI is one of several government schemes aimed at cushioning the effect of high living costs, alongside the HoPE cash transfer programme, which pays ₦25,000 a month for three months to eligible households, and the CREDICORP consumer credit scheme. The government says it is using the national social register to target the poorest households. Critics have questioned whether the payments reach the right people and say the amounts are small compared with rising prices.
## What it means
People who have not been contacted through official channels are being advised to treat any request for payment or personal details with suspicion.
more: Beneficiaries will come from verified official records.
There is no application or nomination process.
Nigerians are warned not to share PINs or OTPs.
stories.alt: A Nigerian 500 naira note

stories.h: Kano court orders TikToker to clean traffic agency offices for two weeks over defamation
stories.p: A Kano magistrate court has reportedly ordered a TikTok user to clean the headquarters of the state traffic agency, KAROTA, for two weeks and write an apology, after finding that his videos defamed the agency's officials.
body: A magistrate court in Kano has handed an unusual sentence to a TikTok user over videos that ridiculed officials of the state's traffic agency.
## The sentence

According to the Kano State Road Traffic Agency (KAROTA), the court found that the TikTok user published videos containing statements that damaged the image of its personnel and exposed them to public ridicule. Magistrate Halima Wali ordered him to clean the agency's headquarters on Club Road, Kano, for two weeks and to carry out any other task the agency considers appropriate. He was also ordered to write a formal letter of apology to KAROTA's management and promise not to repeat the conduct. The agency's spokesman, Abubakar Ibrahim Sharada, confirmed the sentence.
## Background

Non-custodial sentences such as community service are increasingly used by Nigerian courts for minor offences, partly to reduce overcrowding in prisons. Content creators have faced a rising number of cases over online posts in recent years, often under defamation or cybercrime laws. Rights groups have warned that such laws can be used to silence critics, while authorities say people must be held responsible for false or damaging content.
## How people reacted
Many social media users found the sentence amusing and said it was a fair alternative to jail, while others said it showed the risks content creators face when they criticise officials.
more: He must clean KAROTA's headquarters for two weeks.
He was ordered to write an apology.
The court found his videos defamed KAROTA officials.

stories.h: Obasanjo's son Olujuwon joins pro-Tinubu movement, backs President for 2027
stories.p: Olujuwon Obasanjo, a son of former President Olusegun Obasanjo, has reportedly joined the PBAT Door-to-Door Movement as Special Adviser on Political Affairs and pledged to support President Tinubu's re-election. His father has been a fierce critic of the government.
body: A son of former President Olusegun Obasanjo, Olujuwon Obasanjo, has thrown his support behind President Bola Tinubu's bid for a second term.
## What happened

According to reports on Wednesday, 4 November 2026, Olujuwon joined the PBAT Door-to-Door Movement as Special Adviser on Political Affairs during a visit to its headquarters in Abuja, where he was received by the National Coordinator, Sunday Asuku, and shown around the facility. He described the appointment as an honour, praised the movement's community outreach and said he had followed its work for some time.
## What he said

Olujuwon reportedly said the President had started on a good note and urged Nigerians, especially young people, to support the continuation of the government's reforms. He said the country had made progress in several areas and pledged to contribute to the President's re-election.
## Background

The move stands out because his father has been one of the government's harshest critics. Last week, the former President described the government's borrowing as 'absolute nonsense'. The PBAT movement, whose grand patron is former Niger Delta militant leader Government Ekpemupolo (Tompolo), recently launched its Ogun State chapter and donated 26 campaign vehicles. Members of political families supporting different sides is common in Nigerian politics.
## How people reacted

APC supporters welcomed the news, while some critics said it would not change the former President's views or influence voters in Ogun State, where both Obasanjo and the President's allies are active.
more: Olujuwon was named Special Adviser on Political Affairs.
He said the President had started on a good note.
His father has strongly criticised the government.

stories.alt: Former President Olusegun Obasanjo

stories.h: Appeal Court upholds Abdulrahman-led PDP leadership, losing faction heads to Supreme Court
stories.p: The Court of Appeal has dismissed an appeal by Senator Adolphus Wabara and seven others, affirming the PDP National Working Committee led by Abdulrahman Mohammed. The losing faction says it will go to the Supreme Court.
body: The Court of Appeal in Abuja has ruled in favour of the Peoples Democratic Party (PDP) leadership led by Abdulrahman Mohammed, the latest turn in the party's long-running leadership crisis.
## The judgment

On Wednesday, 4 November 2026, a three-member special panel led by Justice Ugochukwu Anthony Ogakwu dismissed an appeal filed by former Senate President Adolphus Wabara and seven others, according to reports. The appellants had asked the court to compel the Independent National Electoral Commission to recognise an interim National Working Committee led by Turaki instead of the Abdulrahman-led NWC. The panel upheld an earlier Federal High Court judgment that backed the Abdulrahman-led committee.
## What happens next
The losing faction announced plans to take the matter to the Supreme Court, vowing to continue the legal battle.
## Background

The PDP, Nigeria's main opposition party for much of the past decade, has been split by leadership disputes since its defeat in the 2023 elections. Several of its leading figures have left to join other parties or opposition coalitions, while others, including FCT Minister Nyesom Wike, have backed President Bola Tinubu. The party has continued to field candidates for the 2027 elections in many states, but its internal crisis has raised questions about its strength.
## Why it matters
Who controls the party's national leadership affects the nomination of candidates and the party's dealings with INEC ahead of the January 2027 elections.
more: The court affirmed the Abdulrahman-led NWC.
The Wabara-led appellants lost.
The losing faction plans to go to the Supreme Court.

stories.h: Court fixes 8 December for judgment in El-Rufai's ₦10bn suit against ICPC
stories.p: A Federal High Court in Abuja has fixed 8 December for judgment in former Kaduna governor Nasir El-Rufai's ₦10 billion rights suit against the ICPC over access to him in custody. The ICPC says his wife broke access rules.
body: A Federal High Court in Abuja will deliver judgment on 8 December 2026 in a ₦10 billion fundamental rights suit filed by former Kaduna State governor Nasir El-Rufai against the Independent Corrupt Practices and Other Related Offences Commission (ICPC).
## The case

Justice Chigozie Onah fixed the date on Wednesday, 4 November, after lawyers for both sides adopted their written arguments, according to reports. The suit, filed on 13 August, concerns access to El-Rufai while he was in the commission's custody. His lawyer argued that CCTV footage shown in court did not prove any security breach by his wife or son that could justify denying them visits.
## The ICPC's position
The ICPC told the court that El-Rufai's wife broke its access rules on two occasions, including entering its premises after official visiting hours.
## Background

El-Rufai governed Kaduna State from 2015 to 2023 and later left the APC to join the opposition coalition that adopted the African Democratic Congress. He has been involved in several legal disputes with anti-corruption agencies, and has appealed publicly for a fair trial. This week he told his supporters, through an ally, to vote for the ADC at every level in 2027.
## What happens next
The court's ruling on 8 December will decide whether the ICPC violated El-Rufai's rights and whether he is entitled to compensation.
more: Judgment is set for 8 December.
The suit concerns family access to El-Rufai in custody.
The ICPC says his wife broke visiting rules.

stories.h: Toyin Abraham asks fans to call her Toyin Aimakhu again for new movie era
stories.p: Actress Toyin Abraham has told fans to call her Toyin Aimakhu, the name she was first known by, for the period of her new film 'Bestie', which is due in cinemas in December.
body: Nollywood actress Toyin Abraham has surprised fans by asking them to call her by her old name.
## What she said

In a post on X on Wednesday, 4 November 2026, the actress wrote that people should call her Toyin Aimakhu for this era. The announcement came as she promotes her upcoming film 'Bestie', which is due to open in cinemas in December.
## Background

The actress was widely known as Toyin Aimakhu early in her career before she became known as Toyin Abraham. Her return to the old name appears to be part of the promotion for the new film. She is one of Nollywood's most successful actresses and producers, with several box office hits to her name. She has recently been in the news over a reported rift with fellow actress Funke Akindele, after an old TikTok collaboration resurfaced.
## How fans reacted
Fans were amused and excited, with many saying they were ready for the 'Toyin Aimakhu era' and wishing her success with the film. Others asked her to bring the movie to their cities.
more: She wants to be called Toyin Aimakhu for this era.
Her new film 'Bestie' is due in December.
Fans welcomed the throwback.

stories.h: MC Oluomo says he is taking adult English lessons, jokes with Lege Miami
stories.p: Transport union president MC Oluomo has reportedly said he is attending adult lessons to improve his spoken English, comparing himself with Lege Miami at a pro-Tinubu rally. He also said his children work in the US as a nurse, a doctor and an engineer.
body: National Union of Road Transport Workers president Musiliu Akinsanya, popularly known as MC Oluomo, has spoken openly about his efforts to improve his English.
## What he said

Speaking at a rally in support of President Bola Tinubu's re-election on Tuesday, 3 November 2026, MC Oluomo reportedly said he was attending adult lessons to sharpen his spoken English. Addressing Nollywood actor Lege Miami, who organised the event, he joked about their shared struggles with the language. He also pointed to his children, who he said work in the United States as a nurse, a doctor and an engineer, as proof of his success.
## Background

MC Oluomo rose from Lagos motor parks to become the national president of the NURTW and is a close ally of the President. He has often been mocked online over his English. At the same rally, Lege Miami broke down in tears while thanking MC Oluomo and others for supporting the event. Separately, a Lagos court this week ordered the arrest of the union's Lagos State chairman over alleged contempt.
## How people reacted
Many people praised MC Oluomo for being honest and willing to keep learning, while others joked about the exchange between him and Lege Miami.
more: MC Oluomo says he is taking adult English lessons.
He joked with Lege Miami at a pro-Tinubu rally.
He says his children work in the US.

stories.h: Soldier rewarded with ₦500,000 for rejecting kidnap suspect's bribe in Plateau
stories.p: The Nigerian Army says Private Utim Terwase refused a ₦500,000 bribe from a kidnapping suspect he had arrested in Plateau State. His commander ordered that he receive a reward equal to the sum he turned down.
body: The Nigerian Army has rewarded a soldier with ₦500,000 for refusing a bribe of the same amount from a suspected kidnapper in Plateau State.
## What happened

According to the Army, Private Utim Terwase arrested a suspected kidnapper after foiling an escape attempt. The suspect then reportedly offered him ₦500,000 to let him go. The soldier refused, handed the suspect over to the appropriate authorities and reported the bribe offer through proper channels.
## The reward

The General Officer Commanding the Army's 3 Division, which runs Operation Enduring Peace in Plateau State, praised the soldier's integrity and directed that he be given a cash reward equal to the bribe he rejected. He urged other soldiers to follow his example.
## Background
Plateau State has suffered repeated attacks by armed groups and kidnappers, and security forces are deployed across the state. Bribery is a long-standing concern in Nigeria's security services.
## How people reacted
Many Nigerians praised the soldier as a role model and said such acts of honesty should be celebrated more often.
more: Private Utim Terwase refused a ₦500,000 bribe.
The suspect was handed to the authorities.
The Army gave him a reward of the same amount.

stories.h: "Zlatan, I'm coming for you, you will learn the hard way": VeryDarkMan fires warning at Zlatan over Davido's viral wedding video
stories.p: VeryDarkMan has reacted angrily to a viral video of Davido singing lyrics that appeared to mock him at Zlatan Ibile's wedding welcome party in Morocco. VDM accuses Zlatan of using his new song, INFERNO, to take a swipe at him, and has warned the singer he will "learn the hard way".
body: Social media activist VeryDarkMan (VDM) has once again stirred controversy after reacting angrily to a viral video of Afrobeats superstar Davido singing lyrics that appeared to mock him at Zlatan Ibile's wedding welcome party in Morocco.
What was supposed to be a moment of celebration has become another talking point online, with VDM accusing Zlatan of using his newly released song, INFERNO, to throw indirect insults at him.
## The lyric that started it
The controversy began after a video surfaced showing Davido enthusiastically singing along to a line that sounded like, "I no be Vincent, I no dey mast…"

For those familiar with VeryDarkMan, whose real name is Martins Vincent Otse, the reference to "Vincent" immediately raised eyebrows, particularly because of his earlier controversial comments about masturbation.
## VDM responds

VDM did not find it funny. In a video shared online, he defended his earlier statements, insisting he saw nothing wrong with his position. According to him, he would rather satisfy himself than go around begging women for attention.
He also questioned why his personal comments had apparently become material for a song, suggesting Zlatan was deliberately taking a swipe at him.
What caught many people's attention was the warning he directed at the singer. Speaking in Pidgin, he said, in effect: "Zlatan, I'm coming for you now. You will learn the hard way."
## The Davido angle

The episode has also brought fresh attention to VDM's relationship with Davido. The two were once publicly friendly, and their association drew plenty of attention online. Their relationship has since appeared strained, with fans often speculating about what went wrong.
Seeing Davido sing along to lyrics VDM believes were aimed at him has only added another chapter to that conversation.
## Was it really about VDM?
There is no confirmed evidence that Zlatan wrote the lyrics to attack VeryDarkMan. That interpretation is VDM's, and the viral clip alone does not show what the singer intended.

Even so, social media users are divided. Some believe VDM is taking an ordinary lyric too personally, while others argue that using a name tied to someone already at the centre of a public controversy was always going to draw a reaction.
Knowing how outspoken VDM can be, many followers are now watching to see whether this ends with his warning or turns into another public confrontation.
## Over to you
Was Zlatan deliberately mocking VeryDarkMan through his song, or is VDM reading too much into the lyrics?
more: Davido was filmed singing a line from Zlatan's INFERNO.
VDM believes the lyric mocks him.
There is no confirmation the line was aimed at VDM.
stories.alt: VeryDarkMan speaking in a video, beside a photo of Zlatan Ibile in a green shirt and sunglasses

stories.h: Carter Efe sparks outrage with harsh words against VeryDarkMan, drags his mother into their feud
stories.p: Comedian and content creator Carter Efe has stirred fresh controversy after a video in which he made a harsh declaration about VeryDarkMan's mother. Many people online say bringing a parent into a social media quarrel goes too far.
body: Popular Nigerian comedian and content creator Carter Efe has stirred fresh controversy on social media after a disturbing statement directed at activist VeryDarkMan (VDM).
## What he said
In a video circulating online, Carter Efe made a harsh declaration involving VeryDarkMan's mother, leaving many people asking how far social media disagreements should be allowed to go.
Speaking in Pidgin, he said, in effect: "VeryDarkMan, if you don't bring me down, your mother will die. Whatever your mother is looking for in this life, she will not find it."
The statement, which amounts to wishing death and misfortune on VDM's mother, has raised concerns about the kind of language being used in online confrontations.
## When feuds go too far

Disagreements between public figures are nothing new in Nigeria. Celebrities exchange insults, make accusations and drag one another for days, and sometimes the whole thing turns into entertainment for their followers.
But bringing someone's mother into a personal disagreement, especially with words wishing her death or misfortune, is something many people consider completely unacceptable.

Whatever the disagreement between Carter Efe and VeryDarkMan may be, one question remains: what has VDM's mother got to do with it? These are parents who may know little or nothing about the arguments their children are having online.
## No explanation yet
At the time of writing, Carter Efe has not publicly explained what led him to make the statement.
## Over to you
Has Carter Efe taken this disagreement too far, or do you believe his words are being taken out of context?
more: Carter Efe made a death wish against VDM's mother in a video.
Many say parents should be kept out of online feuds.
Carter Efe has not explained the statement.

stories.h: Tinubu asks Senate to approve $7.7bn foreign borrowing for 2026 budget
stories.p: President Tinubu has asked the Senate to approve $7.7 billion in new external borrowing, about ₦10.79 trillion, mainly through Eurobonds and loans from international lenders. He said it would fund the 2026 budget and support the naira.
body: President Bola Tinubu has asked the Senate to approve fresh external borrowing of $7.7 billion to help finance the 2026 budget.
## The request

The request was contained in a letter read by Senate President Godswill Akpabio during plenary on Wednesday, 4 November 2026. At the budget exchange rate of ₦1,400 to the dollar, the amount is equal to about ₦10.79 trillion. According to the letter, the money would be raised mainly through Eurobond issuance, as well as loans from multilateral and bilateral lenders, international financial institutions and syndicated loans. The President said the borrowing would help finance the budget, strengthen foreign reserves and support the stability of the naira. He also asked the Senate to authorise the Minister of Finance and the Debt Management Office to carry out the plan.
## What the Senate did

Akpabio said the new request appeared to replace an earlier borrowing proposal and gave more detail on where the money would come from. He referred it to the Senate Committee on Local and Foreign Debts for consideration and a report.
## Background

Nigeria's public debt has risen sharply in recent years, and borrowing has become a major political issue ahead of the 2027 elections. Last week, former President Olusegun Obasanjo described the government's borrowing as 'absolute nonsense', while opposition candidates have warned that debt servicing is taking up too much of government revenue. The government says borrowing is needed to fund infrastructure and that its reforms have improved Nigeria's credit rating and ability to raise money abroad.
## Atiku urges rejection

ADC presidential candidate Atiku Abubakar has called on the Senate to reject the request. In a statement issued through his campaign spokesman, Phrank Shaibu, he warned against giving the government a blank cheque on foreign debt and urged senators to demand a full list of projects, the loan terms and a repayment plan before considering approval. His campaign noted that the request came before the National Assembly had finished considering an earlier external borrowing proposal of $20.52 billion and €1.045 billion.
## What happens next
The Senate committee is expected to review the request before the full Senate votes on it.
more: The request is worth about ₦10.79 trillion.
Funds would come mainly from Eurobonds and international loans.
The Senate referred it to its debt committee.

stories.h: Tinubu says he drove a taxi to pay for his education in the United States
stories.p: President Tinubu says he drove a taxi and took other jobs in the US to fund his university education, and even delayed starting school to save money. He linked the experience to his government's student loan scheme.
body: President Bola Tinubu has shared how he worked to pay for his university education in the United States, saying the experience shaped his government's education policies.
## What he said

In a post on his official X account on Wednesday, 4 November 2026, the President said that when he arrived in the US as a young man, he drove a taxi to earn money for his education, and even had to postpone starting school for several months to save enough. He said he did several other jobs while studying.
## The policy link

Tinubu connected his personal story to his administration's education programmes, pointing to the student loan scheme, investment in medical schools and increased enrolment in nursing training as evidence of efforts to widen access to education.
## Background

The President studied accounting at Chicago State University, graduating in 1979. On Tuesday, Education Minister Tunji Alausa said Tinubu graduated with a first class and described him as a genius, urging Nigerians to ignore opposition questions about his academic record. The Supreme Court dismissed petitions challenging the President's 2023 election, including claims about his certificates. The Nigerian Education Loan Fund, set up in 2024, provides interest-free loans to students in public tertiary institutions.
## How people reacted
Supporters said the story showed the President understood the struggles of young Nigerians, while critics said many students still face high fees and limited opportunities despite the loan scheme.
more: Tinubu says he drove a taxi to pay for his studies.
He delayed starting school to save money.
He linked the story to the student loan scheme.

stories.alt: President Bola Tinubu

stories.h: VeryDarkMan dares Davido's camp to show proof of help, warns Zlatan
stories.p: VeryDarkMan has challenged Davido's associates to show receipts after a social media user claimed the singer once put him up in a Lagos hotel. He also warned Zlatan after Davido was filmed singing along to lyrics believed to target him at Zlatan's wedding party.
body: The feud between social media activist VeryDarkMan (VDM) and singer Davido has flared up again.
## The receipts challenge

On Wednesday, 4 November 2026, VDM shared on his Instagram stories a screenshot of a post by an X user who claimed Davido had once flown him to Lagos, put him up in a five-star hotel and helped him rise to fame. VDM reportedly dismissed the claim and dared Davido or his team to produce proof of any financial support.
## Warning to Zlatan

VDM also reacted angrily to a video from Zlatan Ibile's wedding welcome party in Morocco, in which Davido was seen singing along to lyrics from Zlatan's song 'Inferno', which fans believe is aimed at VDM. In a video, VDM criticised Davido and warned Zlatan that he would learn the hard way, saying he would not take the matter lightly. He also stood by recent controversial comments about his private life that had drawn reactions online.
## Background

VDM and Davido were once close, but their relationship broke down earlier this year. Davido recently unfollowed VDM on Instagram and publicly congratulated Zlatan on the success of 'Inferno', which topped the Apple Music Nigeria chart. Comedian GehGeh this week urged Carter Efe not to fight other people's battles amid the wider VDM controversy.
## Diss track

Later on Wednesday, VDM posted a studio preview of a new diss track aimed at Davido, titled 'On My Knees', which uses Zlatan's signature taglines and which he said would soon be released on streaming platforms.
## How people reacted
Fans were divided, with some backing VDM and others saying he should move on from the feud.
more: VDM dared Davido's team to show proof they helped him.
He warned Zlatan after Davido sang 'Inferno' lyrics.
The feud has run for months.

stories.h: Skales says Burna Boy once asked Davido for space on his private jet
stories.p: Singer Skales says Burna Boy once asked Davido to let them travel on his private jet to a show in Yola where they performed their song 'Temper'. He said the jet was so full that one person sat on the toilet seat.
body: Singer Skales has shared a story from the early days of his career involving two of Nigeria's biggest stars, Burna Boy and Davido.
## What he said

In comments that spread on Wednesday, 4 November 2026, Skales said he and Burna Boy were booked to perform their collaboration 'Temper' at a show in Yola. According to him, Burna Boy contacted Davido and asked if they could travel on his private jet, and Davido agreed. Because the plane was already full, Davido reportedly asked one of his team members to stay behind and fly the next day. Skales said the jet was still so crowded that one person had to sit on the toilet seat during the flight.
## A lucky break
Skales reportedly said the Yola trip led to an important connection for him with the international act Major Lazer, which helped his career.
## Background

'Temper', released in 2014, was one of Skales's biggest hits and featured Burna Boy. Burna Boy and Davido have had a complicated relationship over the years, with periods of rivalry among their fans, although they have also shown respect for each other in public. Both are now global stars, with Burna Boy winning a Grammy in 2021 and Davido receiving multiple Grammy nominations.
## How people reacted
Fans enjoyed the throwback, with some joking about the toilet seat and others saying it showed that the stars once helped each other.
more: Skales says Burna Boy asked Davido for space on his jet.
They were travelling to perform 'Temper' in Yola.
One person reportedly sat on the toilet seat.

stories.h: Court sacks Nasarawa ADC governorship candidate; Rivers APC candidate's case adjourned
stories.p: A Federal High Court in Abuja has nullified the nomination of retired Major General Nuhu Angbazo as the ADC's Nasarawa governorship candidate and ordered a fresh primary. In Port Harcourt, a suit seeking to disqualify Rivers APC candidate Kingsley Chinda was adjourned to 10 December.
body: Two court cases involving governorship candidates for the 2027 elections made news on Wednesday, 4 November 2026.
## Nasarawa ADC candidate sacked

A Federal High Court in Abuja reportedly nullified the nomination of retired Major General Nuhu Angbazo as the governorship candidate of the African Democratic Congress (ADC) in Nasarawa State. Justice Mohammed Umar ruled that the primary election that produced him was inconclusive, and ordered the party to hold a fresh primary in Karu Local Government Area within 14 days. The court also barred INEC from recognising Angbazo as the party's candidate. The case was filed by former Minister of Environment Mohammed Abdullahi, who took part in the primary along with Angbazo and Senator Mohammed Onawo. Angbazo can appeal the judgment.
## Rivers APC case adjourned

In Port Harcourt, a Federal High Court fixed 10 December for hearing in a suit seeking to disqualify Kingsley Chinda, the All Progressives Congress (APC) governorship candidate in Rivers State. The plaintiff, Samuel Amatonjie, argues that Chinda did not properly leave the PDP for the APC under the Constitution, and has asked the court to compel INEC, the Speaker of the House of Representatives and the Clerk of the National Assembly to produce documents on his defection. Chinda has not commented publicly on the case.
## Background

The 2027 party primaries have produced many disputes, and courts have already ordered changes to several candidacies, including the Imo West senatorial ticket. INEC recently removed some candidates from its list, citing a Supreme Court ruling on party membership registers.
more: The court ordered a fresh ADC primary in Karu within 14 days.
INEC was barred from recognising Angbazo.
The Chinda case resumes on 10 December.

stories.h: CAN disowns cleric claiming to be its general secretary, says it backs no candidate
stories.p: The Christian Association of Nigeria says Archbishop Chivir Chianson is not its general secretary and cannot speak for it, after he linked the body to church mobilisation for a candidate. CAN president Daniel Okoh warned the public to disregard such claims.
body: The Christian Association of Nigeria (CAN) has distanced itself from a cleric who presented himself as its general secretary and tried to link the body to support for a candidate in the 2027 elections.
## What CAN said

In a statement signed by its president, Archbishop Daniel Okoh, and reported on Wednesday, 4 November 2026, CAN said Archbishop Chivir Chianson does not hold any position in the association and has no authority to speak or act on its behalf. It said he had tried to identify himself as CAN's general secretary and to associate the body with what he described as a church mobilisation in support of a political candidate. Okoh warned the public and the media to disregard any claim that Chianson or his group represents CAN.
## Neutrality

The statement was widely read as reaffirming CAN's position that it does not endorse any candidate in the race between President Bola Tinubu of the APC, Atiku Abubakar of the ADC and Peter Obi of the NDC.
## Background

Religious leaders and groups have become increasingly involved in the 2027 campaign. A bishops' conference has reportedly endorsed Tinubu for a second term, while a video of a Catholic priest leading his congregation in a song for Obi and Kwankwaso went viral this week. Religion has long been a sensitive issue in Nigerian elections, especially after the APC's Muslim-Muslim ticket in 2023.
## Why it matters
CAN is the umbrella body for most Christian denominations in Nigeria, and its position can influence many voters.
more: CAN says Chianson is not its general secretary.
It warned the public to disregard his claims.
CAN is seen as neutral in the 2027 race.

stories.h: ADC names venue as Atiku kicks off presidential campaign in Sokoto
stories.p: The ADC says Atiku Abubakar's 2027 presidential campaign will be flagged off at its secretariat on Ilorin Road, Sokoto, on Wednesday. The party had kept the venue quiet after alleging intimidation, a convoy attack and the sealing of an office.
body: The African Democratic Congress (ADC) has named the venue for the official launch of Atiku Abubakar's 2027 presidential campaign in Sokoto.
## The venue

According to reports, the campaign will be flagged off at the party's secretariat on Ilorin Road, Sokoto, on Wednesday, 4 November 2026. Senator Ibrahim Lamido, who coordinates the ADC presidential campaign in the state, said Atiku was expected to arrive at Sultan Abubakar III International Airport at about 9am, and invited supporters and members of the public to welcome him before moving to the venue. He urged party executives in all 23 local government areas of the state to mobilise supporters.
## Why the venue was kept quiet

The party had earlier withheld details of the venue, citing alleged intimidation, an attack on the convoy of its governorship candidate and the sealing of one of its campaign offices. On Tuesday, Atiku accused the Department of State Services of recruiting protesters to disrupt the rally, a claim the DSS had not publicly answered. The Sokoto State Government said it sealed the office over questions about who owns the building and to prevent further disturbances.
## Background

Atiku, a former vice-president, is the ADC's candidate after the party became the platform of an opposition coalition. Sokoto is in the North-West, a region with a large share of Nigeria's voters, and is governed by the APC. Other candidates, including President Bola Tinubu of the APC and Peter Obi of the NDC, have also been holding rallies and town halls across the country.
## What happens next
Security agencies are expected to be deployed in Sokoto for the event, and the ADC plans further rallies in other states.
more: The launch holds at the ADC secretariat on Ilorin Road, Sokoto.
Atiku is expected to arrive at 9am.
The party cited intimidation for keeping the venue quiet.

stories.h: Education minister says Tinubu graduated with first class, calls him a genius
stories.p: Education Minister Tunji Alausa has reportedly said President Tinubu graduated with a first class in accounting from Chicago State University and that he has met the President's classmates. He urged Nigerians to ignore opposition doubts about the President's credentials.
body: The Minister of Education, Tunji Alausa, has defended President Bola Tinubu's academic record, describing him as a genius.
## What he said

Speaking on a television politics programme on Tuesday, 3 November 2026, Alausa reportedly said Tinubu graduated with a first class degree in accounting from Chicago State University in the United States. He said he knew the university well, had visited it many times, and had met many of the President's former classmates in person. He urged Nigerians to disregard what he described as the opposition's claims about the President's credentials, and called Tinubu the first internationally exposed president.
## Background

Questions about the President's academic records were raised by opponents before and after the 2023 election. Chicago State University released records confirming that Tinubu graduated in 1979, and the Supreme Court dismissed petitions challenging his election, including claims about his certificates. Opposition figures have continued to raise the issue in political debates. Supporters say the matter has been settled by the courts and the university.
## Background on the minister
Alausa, a medical doctor who practised in the United States, was appointed Minister of Education in 2024. He has introduced several policy changes in the sector.
## How people reacted
APC supporters welcomed the comments, while critics said the minister's remarks would not end the debate and that voters care more about the economy than academic records.
more: Alausa says Tinubu graduated with a first class in accounting.
He says he met the President's classmates in person.
The Supreme Court earlier dismissed petitions over the certificates.

stories.alt: President Bola Tinubu

stories.h: 57 Nigerians at risk as Gambia orders banks to replace foreign staff
stories.p: The Nigerians in Diaspora Commission says 57 Nigerian professionals in four Nigerian-owned banks in The Gambia could lose their jobs after the Gambian central bank ordered banks to replace foreign staff with Gambians by 31 December. The FG has urged a rethink.
body: The federal government has raised concern over a directive by The Gambia's central bank ordering commercial banks to replace foreign employees with Gambian nationals, a move that could cost dozens of Nigerians their jobs.
## The directive
According to reports, the Central Bank of The Gambia issued a circular dated 16 September 2026 giving banks until 31 December 2026 to replace non-Gambian staff with qualified Gambians.
## Nigeria's concern

The Nigerians in Diaspora Commission (NiDCOM) said 57 Nigerian professionals working in four Nigerian-owned banks in The Gambia could be affected. It urged the Gambian authorities to reconsider the directive and to engage with the banks and other stakeholders to reach a fair solution.
## Background

Nigerian banks have expanded across West Africa over the past two decades, with several operating subsidiaries in The Gambia. Both countries are members of the Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS), whose protocols promote the free movement of people and the right to work across member states. Many West African countries, however, have rules encouraging the employment of their own citizens in key sectors.
## Why it matters
The move comes as several countries tighten rules on foreign workers. Nigerians abroad have recently faced stricter immigration policies in the UK, Portugal and elsewhere.
## What happens next
It is not yet clear whether The Gambia will change or delay the policy.
more: The deadline for banks is 31 December 2026.
57 Nigerians in four Nigerian-owned banks could be affected.
NiDCOM urged The Gambia to reconsider.

stories.h: Mr Macaroni earns master's degree with distinction from UK drama school
stories.p: Comedian and actor Mr Macaroni has reportedly graduated with a Master of Arts with Distinction in Performance (Acting) from Mountview Academy of Theatre Arts in London. He shared a video from his convocation with family.
body: Comedian and actor Debo Adedayo, popularly known as Mr Macaroni, has added a new academic achievement to his name.
## What happened

In a video shared on Wednesday, 4 November 2026, the entertainer celebrated graduating with a Master of Arts with Distinction in Performance (Acting) from Mountview Academy of Theatre Arts, a leading drama school in London. The clip showed him at the convocation ceremony surrounded by family members and well-wishers.
## His academic journey
Mr Macaroni previously studied Theatre Arts and Film Studies at Redeemer's University, where he also did postgraduate work in performance, and studied at other institutions in Nigeria.
## Background

Mr Macaroni became one of Nigeria's most popular skit makers with his character, a wealthy and eccentric older man, and has also acted in films and television. He is known for speaking out on social issues and took part in the 2020 EndSARS protests against police brutality. He has also been a vocal commentator on governance and the economy.
## How fans reacted
Fans and colleagues flooded his page with congratulations, praising him for combining comedy with serious study, and saying his achievement was an inspiration to young creatives.
more: He earned an MA with Distinction in Performance (Acting).
The degree is from Mountview Academy of Theatre Arts in London.
Fans praised his commitment to education.

stories.h: Olamide defends Yoruba culture, says black soap is not diabolical
stories.p: Rapper Olamide has said he would happily use Ose Dudu, the traditional black soap often linked to spiritual practices, insisting Yoruba culture should not be demonised. He spoke at a private screening of a film of the same name by actress Sotayo Gaga.
body: YBNL boss Olamide Adedeji, popularly known as Olamide, has spoken in defence of Yoruba culture and tradition.
## What he said

At a private screening of 'Ose Dudu', a new film produced by his friend, actress Sotayo Gaga, on Tuesday, 3 November 2026, Olamide was asked about the traditional black soap of the same name, which some people associate with spiritual or diabolical practices. In a video from the event, he said Yoruba culture and tradition are not diabolical and should not be demonised, and that people should be proud of who they are and where they come from. He said he would not hesitate to use the soap if someone offered it to him.
## Background

Ose dudu, or black soap, is widely used across West Africa for skin care and is made from natural ingredients such as plantain skins, cocoa pods and palm oil. In some contexts it is also prepared with herbs for traditional spiritual purposes, which has led to suspicion among some religious people. Olamide is one of Nigeria's most influential rappers and record label owners, and has launched the careers of several stars.
## How people reacted
Many fans praised Olamide for standing up for African heritage, while others said they would still be careful with traditional products associated with spiritual rites.
more: Olamide says Yoruba tradition should not be demonised.
He spoke at a screening of Sotayo Gaga's film 'Ose Dudu'.
Fans praised him for defending African heritage.

stories.h: Three PDP members die in road crash while on party duty in Kaduna
stories.p: Three PDP members from Jema'a LGA, including the local party secretary, reportedly died in a crash on the Kaduna–Kafanchan road while on official party duties. ADC governorship candidate Isa Ashiru was among those who sent condolences.
body: Three members of the Peoples Democratic Party (PDP) from Jema'a Local Government Area of Kaduna State have died in a road accident while on party duty, according to reports on Wednesday, 4 November 2026.
## Who died

The victims were identified as Caleb Ishaya Alot, the PDP secretary for Jema'a LGA; Mercy Achi, the party's zonal women leader for its Wise Women group in Jema'a; and Charity Bahago, a member of the same group. The crash happened on the Kaduna–Kafanchan road. Details of how the accident happened have not been released.
## Condolences

Isa Mohammed Ashiru, the African Democratic Congress governorship candidate in Kaduna State, was among the first to react. He said he received the news with profound shock and sadness and sent his condolences to the PDP leadership at state, zonal and local levels, as well as to the families of the victims.
## Background

Road accidents are a leading cause of death in Nigeria, and campaign periods often see a rise in travel by party officials and supporters on busy highways. Earlier this week, a local government chairman in Bauchi State died in a road crash while returning from a party meeting.
## What happens next
The PDP is expected to announce burial arrangements in consultation with the families.
more: The victims included the Jema'a PDP secretary.
The crash happened on the Kaduna–Kafanchan road.
An ADC candidate was among those who sent condolences.

stories.h: Mary Njoku questions NAFDAC chief over unsafe food products
stories.p: Actress and filmmaker Mary Njoku has asked NAFDAC Director-General Mojisola Adeyeye whether Nigerians are now safe from fake and unsafe products, criticising what she called a cycle of outrage with no results.
body: Nollywood actress and filmmaker Mary Njoku has publicly questioned the head of the National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control (NAFDAC), Professor Mojisola Adeyeye, over continuing concerns about fake and unsafe products in Nigeria.
## What she said

In a social media post on Wednesday, 4 November 2026, Njoku recalled the NAFDAC chief's laughter during a recent food safety controversy, which she said she would never forget, and asked whether Nigerians are actually safe now. She criticised what she described as a familiar Nigerian cycle in which people raise an alarm, nothing is resolved, and attention moves to the next controversy. She also asked whether ordinary people now need special expertise to know whether their food is safe.
## Background

Food safety has been a major public concern in Nigeria this year, with reports of fake and expired products, altered expiry dates and contaminated foods. This week, police in Kano arrested traders accused of changing expiry dates on milk, and a processor in Ondo was arrested over unhygienic food handling. NAFDAC has carried out raids and destroyed large quantities of unsafe products, but critics say enforcement remains weak.
## Who is Mary Njoku
Mary Njoku is an actress, producer and the founder of the ROK Studios film company, which she sold to the French broadcaster Canal+ in 2019. She remains one of Nollywood's most influential figures.
## How people reacted

Many Nigerians agreed with her, sharing their own fears about unsafe products, while others urged consumers to report suspicious goods to the agency. NAFDAC had not responded publicly at the time of reporting.
more: Njoku asked whether Nigerians are now safe from unsafe products.
